name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti & Ministry of Agriculture
description: National mission aimed at achieving convergence of investments in irrigation at the field level, expanding cultivable area under assured irrigation (Har Khet Ko Pani), and improving on-farm water-use efficiency (Per Drop More Crop).
target_region: Pan-India, with special focus on drought-prone and water-stressed districts in UP Bundelkhand, MP, and Marathwada
objectives: Expand gross irrigated area from 49% to over 56% nationwide
Reduce waterlogging and soil salinization in canal command areas
Promote micro-irrigation (drip & sprinkler) for intensive crop rotation
Enhance groundwater recharge in depleted aquifers
observed_impact_summary: District-level time series data shows irrigated agricultural land share increased by +4.1% in Uttar Pradesh and +10.2% in Madhya Pradesh post-2015, coinciding with canal modernization and micro-irrigation subsidies.
methodology_note: Before/After longitudinal comparison using MoA&FW Land Use Statistics and CGWB ground water monitoring stations. Observed association does not necessarily imply direct isolated causation.

name: Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (Bhu-Aadhaar / ULPIN)
ministry: Department of Land Resources, Ministry of Rural Development
description: A major national e-governance initiative to build a transparent, integrated land information management system by computerizing Records of Rights (RoRs), digitizing cadastral maps with GIS georeferencing, and assigning a 14-digit Unique Land Parcel Identification Number.
objectives: 100% digital cadastral map integration with spatial parcel boundaries
Real-time mutation synchronization between Sub-Registrar Offices and Tehsils
Reduction of land dispute litigation and title uncertainty in agricultural parcels
Single-window citizen access to certified spatial land records
observed_impact_summary: State records indicate a 64% decrease in unregistered partition disputes and over 91% geo-referencing of village parcel maps in pilot districts across UP, MP, and Maharashtra.
methodology_note: Administrative audit data combined with DoLR quarterly MIS filings.

name: National Mission for a Green India (GIM)
ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change
description: One of the eight missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC) aimed at protecting, restoring, and enhancing India's forest cover through agro-forestry and eco-restoration of degraded lands.
target_region: Vulnerable forest corridors, Western Ghats, Central Indian Highlands, and degraded catchment areas
objectives: Increase forest/tree cover to 33% of geographic area in target landscapes
Enhance carbon sequestration by 50-60 million tonnes annually by 2030
Improve livelihood opportunities for 3 million forest-dependent households
observed_impact_summary: Forest cover in Madhya Pradesh and Karnataka stabilized with moderate gains in open and community-managed forests (+0.5% to +0.8% increase in forest share).
methodology_note: FSI biennial satellite canopy assessment normalized across terrain gradients.
